interpretation: Prompt 17 illustrative 45/50/55 t/day throughput points are linear stoichiometric reference scenarios around the illustrative 50 t/day case; they are not probabilistic uncertainty bounds, approved capacity range, equipment feasibility cases or plant performance predictions.
method: Each throughput point is recalculated through the material-balance engine using the versioned reaction network. R-02 extent is scaled in proportion to the base-case R-02 extent relative to the methanol component-equivalent basis.
